camel_example: aliyun ndr DescribeProtoLogDeliveryStatus --region cn-hangzhou --DeliveryType sls --version 2024-01-24 --method POST --force
description_en: Queries log delivery switches for protocol logs and attack logs across sites. Log delivery switches and the Simple Log Service (SLS) destination status represent different information. To query destinations and their availability status, call the DescribeDeliveryDestination operation
description_zh: 查询各站点的协议日志和攻击日志投递开关。投递开关与 SLS 目的地状态分别表示不同信息；目的地及其可用状态通过 DescribeDeliveryDestination 查询
name: DescribeProtoLogDeliveryStatus

parameters.help_en: The delivery type. You must set this parameter to sls, which indicates delivery to Simple Log Service (SLS)
parameters.help_zh: 投递类型，必须传入 sls，表示投递到日志服务 SLS
parameters.name: delivery_type

schema.description_en: The response structure of the operation

Data.description_en: The query result of the log delivery switches
Data.description_zh: 日志投递开关查询结果

DeliveryType.description_en: The delivery type for the current query. The current value is sls
DeliveryType.description_zh: 本次查询的投递类型，当前为 sls

StatusList.description_en: The list of log delivery switches for each site. An empty list is returned if log delivery is not enabled
StatusList.description_zh: 各站点的日志投递开关列表；未开通日志投递时返回空列表

AttackLogStatus.description_en: The log delivery switch for attack logs. A value of 0 indicates shutdown. A value of 1 indicates enabled
AttackLogStatus.description_zh: 攻击日志投递开关。0 表示关闭，1 表示开启

DeliveryType.description_en: The delivery type of the site. The current value is sls
DeliveryType.description_zh: 该站点的投递类型，当前为 sls

ProtoLogStatus.description_en: The log delivery switch for protocol logs. A value of 0 indicates shutdown. A value of 1 indicates enabled
ProtoLogStatus.description_zh: 协议日志投递开关。0 表示关闭，1 表示开启

Site.description_en: The identifier of the log delivery site. A value of global indicates unified delivery for a single site. Values of cn, intl, and gov indicate the China site, International site, and Alibaba Gov Cloud site, respectively
Site.description_zh: 日志投递站点标识。global 表示单站点统一投递；cn、intl、gov 分别表示中国站、国际站和政务云站点

ErrorCode.description_en: The error code returned when the request fails. This parameter is empty when the request succeeds. The example shows a failure scenario
ErrorCode.description_zh: 请求失败时的错误码；请求成功时为空。示例展示失败场景

Message.description_en: The request result message. This parameter describes the cause of the error when the request fails. The example shows a parameter validation failure scenario
Message.description_zh: 请求结果信息；失败时用于说明错误原因。示例展示参数校验失败场景

RequestId.description_zh: 请求 ID，用于定位本次请求

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request is successful. Valid values: true: The request is successful. false: The request fails
Success.description_zh: 请求是否成功。true 表示成功，false 表示失败
